description.value: Kensington Community Centre & Pool is a City of Vancouver civic facility serving the Kensington-Cedar Cottage neighbourhood. The centre includes an aquatic facility, making it a practical stop for touring cyclists seeking washrooms or a swim. As a publicly operated recreation centre, it is open to drop-in visitors from the general public.
